program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((seed (first (find-color g 2)))
         (dist (make-hash)))
    (define queue (list (cons (first seed) (second seed))))
    (hash-set! dist (first queue) 0)
    (let bfs ([step 0])
      (unless (empty? queue)
        (let ((cur (first queue)))
          (set! queue (rest queue))
          (for ([d (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
            (let ((nr (+ (car cur) (first d)))
                  (nc (+ (cdr cur) (second d))))
              (when (and (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                         (not (= (at g nr nc) 8))
                         (not (hash-has-key? dist (cons nr nc))))
                (hash-set! dist (cons nr nc) (+ (hash-ref dist cur) 1))
                (set! queue (append queue (list (cons nr nc))))))))
        (bfs (+ step 1))))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (hash-has-key? dist (cons r c))
            (if (even? (hash-ref dist (cons r c))) 3 4)
            (at g r c))))))
